ORIGINAL RESEARCH

The 2026 U.S. Commercial Demand Charge Index

We analyzed hundreds of active commercial utility tariffs to determine which states expose small businesses to the highest demand charge risks.

Key Findings

  • California and Texas lead the nation in "RATCHET" demand clauses, meaning a single summer peak can penalize a business for 12 months.
  • Midwest states show a higher prevalence of "MID" demand bands, heavily impacting manufacturing and cold-storage facilities.
  • Over 40% of analyzed tariffs contain hidden riders that effectively act as secondary demand charges.

📊 Methodology & Limits

This index is built from the OpenEI Utility Rate Database (URDB). It represents a point-in-time snapshot of active commercial tariffs. It excludes municipal cooperatives that do not publish digital rate sheets. "Not Available" states indicate insufficient public data, not zero demand charges.
